preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(N, int) and N >= 1 for N in test_cases_N)
preconditions.description: For each test case, N is a positive integer representing the size of the permutation.

preconditions.expression: all(len(A) == N and set(A) == set(range(1, N + 1)) for A, N in zip(test_cases_A, test_cases_N))
preconditions.description: Each input array A is a permutation of integers from 1 to N.
The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 500,000.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly T lines, one for each test case.

postconditions.expression: all(all(isinstance(x, int) and 1 <= x <= N for x in parsed_out) and len(parsed_out) == N for parsed_out, N in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines], test_cases_N))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a space-separated sequence of N integers, each between 1 and N.

postconditions.expression: all(set(parsed_out) == set(range(1, N + 1)) for parsed_out, N in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines], test_cases_N))
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid permutation of 1 to N.

postconditions.expression: all(out_perm == min((rotated for rotated in (A[i:] + A[:i] for i in range(N))), key=lambda x: x) or out_perm == min((rotated for rotated in (A[i:] + A[:i] for i in range(N))), key=lambda x: x) for out_perm, A, N in zip([list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdout_lines], test_cases_A, test_cases_N))
postconditions.description: Each output permutation is the lexicographically smallest among all permutations reachable by applying at most two swaps to the input permutation and then any number of left cyclic shifts.
